  • Mitral Valve Prolapse and Ventricular Arrhythmia Risk in TTN-Mediated Cardiomyopathy: A Single Center Experience.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • Prognostic Impact of Ventricular Arrhythmia Timing in Acute Coronary Syndromes Treated with Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在ACS接受PCI的患者中，围术期室性心律失常显著增加短期和长期死亡风险，且PCI后发生的VA短期死亡风险最高。
  • Pacemaker-associated bigeminy.
    J Electrocardiol · 2026-10-23
    起搏器相关二联律可由六种特定算法-节律相互作用机制引起，识别这些模式有助于区分正常设备功能与故障。
  • Profound sinus bradycardia preceding ventricular tachycardia storm during emergence from anesthesia in a patient with a prior inferior myocardial infarction: a case report
    JA Clinical Reports · 2026-10-23
    一例既往下壁心梗的血透患者在全麻苏醒期出现严重窦性心动过缓，阿托品处理后心率恢复但节律异常持续，随后发生室速风暴，提示心动过缓治疗后持续节律异常需重新评估。
  • High-Grade Atrioventricular Block and Recurrent Cardiac Arrest in Suspected Isolated Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-23
    18岁女性反复晕厥，出现高级别房室传导阻滞及反复缓慢型心脏骤停，影像提示疑似孤立性心脏结节病，激素治疗后植入CRT-D。
  • Cardiac screening in the young for the detection of cardiovascular disease and prevention of sudden cardiac death.
    PLoS Med · 2026-10-23
    本文为综述，指出年轻人猝死多源于静默性遗传性心脏病，AI辅助的结构化筛查框架有望提升疾病检出与风险预测，但全球政策框架尚不统一。
  • Prolonged QT Interval in Hospitalized Internal Medicine Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study of Determinants and Reversibility.
    Rom J Intern Med · 2026-10-23
    在277例住院内科患者中，Bazett公式较Framingham公式显著高估QT间期延长，仅28.1%经QTcF确认；QT延长多为获得性且可逆。

器械治疗（10）

  • Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
  • Beyond the light-driven pacemaker: the suprachiasmatic nucleus as a dynamic coordinator of environmental cues
    Front Neurosci · 2026-10-24
  • Transvenous Lead Extraction Without Dedicated Surgical Back up in Low-Risk Patients.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在482例低风险经静脉导线拔除患者中，无外科待命团队支持下主要并发症发生率仅0.83%，无患者需外科抢救。
  • Ten-year Performance of the Multi-Layer Insulated Defibrillation Lead in the Medicare Population.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在26830例Medicare患者中，Optisure ICD导线10年无机械并发症生存率为97.2%（最佳情景）至95.6%（最差情景），表现良好。
  • [Psychotherapeutic interventions for reducing stress in patients with cardiac arrhythmias].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    综述指出，对心律失常患者（尤其ICD术后）进行心理教育及基础心身干预，可打破焦虑-症状恶性循环，减少创伤后应激，但需建立心理-心脏团队。
  • Conduction System Pacing Versus Biventricular Pacing for Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-23
    8项RCT共799例CRT患者中，CSP与BVP在ΔLVEF上无显著差异（+2.40%，P=0.091），但仅纳入LBBB患者的研究提示CSP可能更优。
  • Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy Using a Conduction System Pacing Defibrillation Lead in Patients Meeting CRT-D Indications: Six-Month Clinical Outcomes Results From the ASCEND CSP Study.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    在52例符合CRT-D适应证的患者中，使用专用CSP ICD导线行LOT-CRT植入成功率达98.1%，除颤有效，6个月LVEF改善和CRT反应优于匹配的传统BiV-CRT。
  • Evaluation of Acute Electrical and Hemodynamic Improvement During Left Bundle‐Branch Area Pacing Modalities for Resynchronization Therapy
    Journal of the American Heart Association · 2026-10-23
    在24例心衰合并LBBB患者中，选择性左束支起搏提供最大急性血流动力学获益（ΔSBP 16.3 mmHg），且血流动力学最优AV间期比QRS最窄AV间期短18-29 ms。
  • Circadian rhythms in health and disease.
    Mol Biomed · 2026-10-23
    该综述系统阐述昼夜节律通过BMAL1、CLOCK等核心时钟基因调控代谢、免疫与神经活动，其紊乱与神经退行性疾病、代谢病、肿瘤及心血管病发生进展相关，并提出时间治疗与个体化医疗的转化路径。
  • [Atypical Course of Pacemaker Leads via the Accessory Hemiazygos Vein on Chest Radiography in a Patient with a Hypoplastic Left Brachiocephalic Vein].
    Rofo · 2026-10-23

心力衰竭与代谢（4）

  • Clinically Motivated Redesign of the Pennsylvania State University Child Ventricular Assist Device.
    ASAIO J · 2026-10-23
    PSU儿童心室辅助装置转子经计算优化为五叶片设计，在模拟循环回路中液压性能提升约40%，溶血指数低，为儿科心衰提供更高效可植入装置。
  • Wearable Heart Rate Monitoring in Resource-Limited Healthcare
    Advances in computational intelligence and robotics book series · 2026-10-23
    该综述指出，基于光电容积脉搏波的可穿戴设备结合TinyML可在无网络连接下实现实时心律失常检测，为资源有限地区提供低成本连续心脏监测路径。
  • A study protocol of fasting to provide energy needed to help adults in need of cognitive enhancement (Fasting ENHANCE).
    Exp Gerontol · 2026-10-23
    Fasting ENHANCE 研究方案拟在超重伴主观认知下降的老年人中，以评估者盲法随机对照设计检验 6 个月 8 小时限时进食能否改善认知功能。
  • Interventricular septal LGE predicts response trajectories and clinical prognosis in heart failure patients undergoing left bundle branch area pacing.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在非缺血性心肌病合并完全性左束支传导阻滞患者中，室间隔纤维化程度可独立预测左束支区域起搏的应答轨迹与预后，室间隔LGE%每升高1%，不良应答进展风险增加14%。

遗传与基础（9）

  • Polycystin dysfunction and cardiac electrical abnormalities in ADPKD.
    Am J Nephrol · 2026-10-23
    ADPKD中多囊蛋白功能异常通过钙稳态失衡等机制导致心脏电重构，表现为QT/QTc延长、房颤和室性心律失常，需加强心肾联合管理。
  • Arrhythmic Risk Stratification in Non-Ischaemic Cardiomyopathy: The Role of Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
    Curr Cardiol Rep · 2026-10-23
    在非缺血性心肌病中，LGE-CMR 检测的替代性纤维化是室性心律失常和心源性猝死的强独立预测因子，其缺失可识别低危人群，CMR 已成为心律失常风险分层基石。
  • Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Novel Biphenyl Derivatives with Therapeutic Potential for Atrial Fibrillation by Synergistically Inhibiting NaV1.5 Late Na+ Current and K+ Current.
    J Med Chem · 2026-10-23
    新型联苯衍生物8b通过协同抑制晚钠电流和IKr，在兔AF模型中显示抗心律失常疗效，且避免传导阻滞和QT延长，对多柔比星心衰小鼠有效。
  • Electrophysiological remodeling in the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy MYBPC3 R943X mutant in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes and modulation by IKto-targeting drugs.
    J Mol Cell Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    携带MYBPC3 R943X突变的hiPSC-CMs表现出显著的电生理重构和致心律失常特征，Kv4通道调节剂NS-5806可部分恢复其正常动作电位形态。
  • Congenital Long QT Syndrome Type 2: Delayed Diagnosis After a Decade of Seizure-Like Episodes.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-23
    93岁男性因反复惊厥样晕厥就诊，基因检测确诊先天性长QT综合征2型，提示高龄患者持续QT延长需考虑遗传性病因。
  • Clinical integration of artificial intelligence for diagnosis, risk prediction and management of rare cardiovascular diseases
    Journal of Basic and Clinical Physiology and Pharmacology · 2026-10-23
    人工智能可提升罕见心血管病的诊断准确性、风险分层和个体化治疗决策，但临床落地仍需标准化多中心数据、前瞻性验证和可解释算法。
  • Sex Differences in the Associations of Age‐Related Genetic Predisposition With Incident Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Cohort Study
    Journal of the American Heart Association · 2026-10-23
    在UK Biobank前瞻性队列中，AF多基因风险评分的年龄相关轨迹存在性别差异：40-49岁男性关联更强，60-69岁女性关联更强。
  • Research trends and hotspot analysis of sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
    Medicine · 2026-10-23
    文献计量分析显示，肥厚型心肌病相关心脏性猝死研究呈指南驱动式增长，热点已从机制研究转向多模态风险预测、AI模型与靶向药物治疗。
  • Arrhythmic events and genetic variants as drivers for Takotsubo Syndrome: a patient-specific atrial stem-cell model.
    Signal Transduct Target Ther · 2026-10-23
    TTS患者来源的心房iPSC-CM在异丙肾上腺素刺激下出现SR钙漏和致心律失常表型，PDE4激活剂MR-L2可逆转异常并预防心律失常，优于β受体阻滞剂。

其他（9）

  • It's about time: modeling circadian regulation of cardiac electrophysiology and arrhythmogenesis.
    Am J Physiol Cell Physiol · 2026-10-23
    本综述提出将昼夜节律调控整合到心脏电生理计算模型中，以更准确模拟心律失常易感性和药物反应的时间依赖性。
  • Procedural Success, Predictors of Failure, and Clinical Outcomes of Conduction System Pacing in Korea: The Korean Conduction System Pacing (K-CSP) Registry.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    韩国多中心注册研究显示，传导系统起搏成功率达87.4%，直接夺获传导系统（LBBP+LFP）较LVSP与更低的心衰住院调整风险相关（HR 3.04），但事件数少，需随机试验验证。
  • Undiagnosed Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy Hidden in Explanted Hearts: Insights from a Single Tertiary Center.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • A Technique for Slack Formation During Proximal Left Bundle Branch Pacing With a Lumenless Defibrillation Lead.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • Developing an Institutional Paediatric EP Practice in Hong Kong: our reflections.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-23
  • Immunohistochemical markers for dating cardiac conduction system injury: current knowledge and forensic implications.
    Int J Legal Med · 2026-10-23
    综述指出，用于心室肌损伤时间推断的免疫组化标志物不能直接套用于心脏传导系统，需专门验证。
  • Embolic Myocardial Infarction From Delayed Left Bundle Lead Perforation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
  • A lightweight progressive residual convolutional network for interpretable arrhythmia classification.
    Phys Eng Sci Med · 2026-10-23
    提出轻量级渐进残差卷积注意力网络DResCA，在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库五分类任务中达到98.35%准确率和97.99%宏F1，参数量少于主流深度学习模型。
  • Ballistic Drift and Wavefront Breakup of Scroll Waves Induced by Ordered Discrete Bagua Heterogeneity
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-23
    在Barkley反应扩散模型中，有序离散的八卦构型异质性场可诱导螺旋波从刚性旋转转为方向锁定的弹道漂移，并最终导致波前破碎和缺陷介导的湍流，其机制不同于随机噪声或单一障碍物。

item.title: 2026-10-23 心脏电生理日报（21 篇）
item.description:
共 21 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（10）

  • Predictive Value of the HALP Score for Post-Operative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery
    Angiology · 2026-10-22
    在448例CABG患者中，HALP评分对术后房颤的预测能力优于其他4项营养-炎症指标（AUC 0.812），将其纳入LASSO基础模型后联合模型AUC达0.897，内部验证校正AUC 0.885。
  • Intraoperative New-onset Atrial Fibrillation during Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography: A Peri-anesthetic Challenge.
    Ann Afr Med · 2026-10-22
  • Recurrence analysis of cardiac arrhythmias: A systematic review of methods, substrate characterisation and clinical translation
    Computers in Biology and Medicine · 2026-10-22
    系统综述49项研究显示，复发量化分析可揭示颤动信号的非随机结构，但方法学异质性大、阈值选择缺乏标准，仅1项前瞻性研究用于消融指导，临床转化尚未成熟。
  • Managing Atrial Fibrillation in the Athlete: Practical Insights Beyond the Guidelines
    Current Treatment Options in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-22
  • Source-Specific PM2.5 Exposure and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in U.S. Older Adults: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
    Environ Health (Wash) · 2026-10-22
    在美国老年人群中，长期暴露于交通、重油/煤燃烧、二次硫酸盐和二次硝酸盐来源的PM2.5与房颤风险增加相关，且存在地域异质性。
  • Nationwide assessment of early hospitalizations and mortality after pulsed field ablation.
    Europace · 2026-10-22
  • Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-22
    左心耳形态分型与血栓风险相关但受临床情境影响，传统分型与血液淤滞不直接相关，定量几何参数和数字孪生技术可更精准识别高风险患者。
  • Frequent Premature Ventricular Complexes and Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-22
    房颤消融患者中频发室早（≥1%）基线患病率18.4%，消融后179天内新发9.0%、逆转10.9%，但2年随访≥1%室早比例显著增加，基线室早负荷和高血压是唯一预测因素。
  • Decoding Atrial Fibrillation Heterogeneity
    JACC Advances · 2026-10-22
  • Aveir VR for Atrial Leadless Pacing in Young Patients
    Pediatric Cardiology · 2026-10-22
    在5例14-17岁男性窦房结功能障碍患者中，经股静脉将Aveir VR无导线起搏器植入心房，随访1-23个月起搏参数稳定，无并发症报告。

室性心律失常（5）

  • Unexpected Death in a Preschool Child
    American Journal of Forensic Medicine & Pathology · 2026-10-22
    一例4岁儿童因左心室肥厚基础上发生心肌炎导致意外死亡，提示临床需高度警惕心肌炎并规范尸检流程。
  • Antenatally detected right ventricular outflow tract aneurysm with neonatal ventricular arrhythmia.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-22
    一例产前超声偶然发现的胎儿右室流出道巨大室壁瘤，新生儿期出现右室流出道起源频发室早，早期胺碘酮治疗后心律失常迅速消失。
  • Validity of Administrative ICD-10 Diagnosis Codes for Ventricular Arrhythmia and Cardiac Arrest in a French University Hospital.
    Clin Epidemiol · 2026-10-22
    在法国亚眠大学医院182例患者中，ICD-10编码识别室性心律失常和心脏骤停的阳性预测值均较高（0.93-0.99），支持用于药物流行病学研究。
  • Unexpected Non-immune Hydrops Foetalis With Supraventricular Tachycardia in a Premature Neonate
    Cureus · 2026-10-22
  • Prolonged QT Interval in Hospitalized Internal Medicine Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study of Determinants and Reversibility
    Romanian Journal of Internal Medicine · 2026-10-22
    在277例住院内科患者中，Bazett公式较Framingham公式显著且心率依赖性高估QT间期延长，仅28.1%患者经QTcF确认延长，QT延长多为获得性且可逆。

遗传与基础（3）

  • Post-hospitalisation COVID-19 study: a national consortium to understand and improve long-term health outcomes (PHOSP-COVID) - COV0319
    2026-10-22
    PHOSP-COVID 研究纳入 7935 例 COVID-19 住院后出院者，5 个月时仅约 30% 完全康复，1 年时改善有限，女性、35-65 岁、肥胖、多病共存或机械通气者恢复更差。
  • Risk stratification in early non-ischaemic cardiomyopathy: the interplay of genetics and cardiac imaging.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-22
    综述指出，早期非缺血性心肌病仅凭LVEF进行危险分层不足，整合CMR-LGE纤维化负荷与基因型特异性表型可推动更个性化的猝死预防策略。
  • Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis in peripheral neuropathy: prevalence, clinical features, and neurology-based screening in non-endemic Japan
    Frontiers in Neurology · 2026-10-22
    在日本非流行区神经内科疑似周围神经病患者中，ATTRv患病率为2.31%，3例均无家族史且伴心脏受累，心电图低电压可能提示隐匿性心脏淀粉样变。

其他（3）

  • First-tier copy-number variant analysis in inherited cardiomyopathy: reconsidering the case for second-tier triage.
    Europace · 2026-10-22
  • Immunohistochemical markers for dating cardiac conduction system injury: current knowledge and forensic implications
    International Journal of Legal Medicine · 2026-10-22
    综述指出，用于心室肌损伤时间推断的免疫组化标志物（如C5b-9、肌钙蛋白、纤连蛋白、连接蛋白43）不能直接套用于心脏传导系统，亟需组织特异性验证研究。
  • Disseminated Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma to the Sympathetic Chain Causing VT Storm.
    JACC CardioOncol · 2026-10-22

item.title: 2026-10-22 心脏电生理日报（9 篇）
item.description:
共 9 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（5）

  • Epidemiology, comorbidity profiles, and oral anticoagulation patterns among patients with atrial fibrillation in Turkey: a meta-analysis of national registry-based and multicenter observational studies.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-10-21
    土耳其6项注册研究共18,219例AF患者的荟萃分析显示，NOAC使用率在全体入组注册中约60%、总体OAC约88%，但消融（3%）与复律（9%）等节律控制措施使用率低。
  • Association between insulin resistance-related indices and the risk of recurrence after catheter ablation in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
    Cardiovasc Diabetol · 2026-10-21
    在非瓣膜性房颤首次消融患者中，eGDR、CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR与术后1年复发风险独立相关，其中eGDR预测性能最佳。
  • Source-Specific PM2.5 Exposure and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in U.S. Older Adults: A Nationwide Cohort Study
    Environment & Health · 2026-10-21
  • Nationwide assessment of early hospitalizations and mortality after pulsed field ablation
    Europace · 2026-10-21
  • Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-21

室性心律失常（1）

  • Sudden cardiac arrest during diagnostic workup: a rare case of high-risk interarterial left anterior descending artery anomaly.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-21
    65岁女性因心绞痛行负荷试验后，在冠脉CTA检查中发生室颤导致心脏骤停，确诊为左前降支动脉间走行高危异常，行搭桥手术并结扎近端分支后恢复良好。

器械治疗（1）

  • Cardiac MRI at 3.0T in the presence of implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs)
    medRxiv · 2026-10-21
    在3.0T临床磁共振上，采用宽频带PSIR LGE和扰相GRE CINE序列，可对植入ICD的患者完成心脏磁共振成像，多数扫描伪影得到充分抑制。

遗传与基础（1）

  • Integrated proteomics and machine learning reveal AHNAK as a discriminative biomarker of atrial fibrillation in heart failure.
    BMC Med · 2026-10-21
    在急性失代偿性心衰患者中，血浆AHNAK蛋白可有效区分房颤（AUC=0.897），其表达降低与心房纤维化及房颤风险增加相关。

其他（1）

  • First-tier copy-number variant analysis in inherited cardiomyopathy: reconsidering the case for second-tier triage
    Europace · 2026-10-21

item.title: 2026-10-21 心脏电生理日报（24 篇）
item.description:
共 24 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（12）

  • A Conservatively Managed Giant Ascending Aortic Aneurysm Presenting With New Atrial Fibrillation and Heart Failure.
    Cureus · 2026-10-20
    88岁女性新发房颤伴心衰，超声意外发现9.3 cm升主动脉瘤，因高龄衰弱未手术，保守治疗并抗凝，2个月随访瘤体未增大。
  • Maintenance of atrial fibrillation by reciprocal triggering of competitive focal sources: a hypothesis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    该假说提出，房颤的维持可能源于多个竞争性局灶源（由延迟后除极相互触发）的周期性主导切换，而非完整折返，这解释了Cox迷宫术和肺静脉隔离的成功机制。
  • Case Report: Angiography-guided transvenous single-chamber pacemaker implantation in mirror-image dextrocardia with congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    本例为镜像右位心合并先天性矫正型大动脉转位患者，经右腋静脉造影引导植入单腔起搏器，手术成功且随访1年稳定。
  • Single versus double transseptal puncture for atrial fibrillation radiofrequency ablation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    单次房间隔穿刺与双次穿刺在房颤射频消融中3个月窦性心律维持率、透视时间和并发症发生率相当，但单次穿刺手术时间显著延长。
  • Efficacy, safety, and strategy-modifying factors of pulsed field ablation for persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    在持续性及长程持续性房颤中，脉冲场消融总体有效且安全，12个月无房性心律失常复发率约66%-83%，对比冷冻球囊复发风险更低（RR 0.71），但证据确定性低至极低。
  • Physiologic Stress During Walking and Cycling Early After Cardiac Surgery.
    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
    心脏术后早期，6分钟步行试验中的心脏做功（总心搏数/步行距离）可行，且与踏车试验的心率反应相似；女性与更高心脏做功独立相关，房颤与较低心率相关，衰弱程度高则步行距离更短。
  • Long-Term Association Between Comprehensive Cardiac Rehabilitation and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Rhythm-Control Interventions.
    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
  • Pulsed Field Ablation for Cardiac Arrhythmias: Industry Landscape and US Food and Drug Administration-approved Platforms (2025).
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    综述指出PFA已从实验技术成为房颤一线消融疗法，FDA批准的多种平台正推动其向局灶和混合消融策略演进。
  • Evaluation and Classification of Atrial Arrhythmias from Signatures in Electrographic Flow Metrics.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在151例房颤消融患者中，电解剖血流标测的失组织化评分和平均血流一致性可区分房颤、微折返房扑与局灶房速，多层感知器模型鉴别准确率达81%。
  • Impact of Frailty on Recurrence After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在房颤导管消融患者中，衰弱使房性快速性心律失常复发风险增加57%（RR 1.57，95%CI 1.26-1.94），应纳入术前风险分层。
  • Atrial fibrillation in stroke patients: facts, numbers and current challenges.
    Neurol Res Pract · 2026-10-20
    房颤是缺血性卒中可干预的重要危险因素，20-30%卒中患者存在房颤；不同临床情境下抗凝策略需个体化，新治疗手段尚需随机对照试验验证。
  • Spanish catheter ablation registry. 25th official report of the Heart Rhythm Association of the Spanish Society of Cardiology (2025).
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-20
    2025年西班牙导管消融注册研究显示，共109个中心完成33,435例消融，房颤仍是最常见心律失常（14,452例），脉冲场消融使用率显著增至37%，总体急性成功率95%、并发症率1.6%、死亡率0.04%。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Late gadolinium enhancement dispersion mapping predicts major arrhythmic events in patients with prior myocardial infarction.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-20
    在364例陈旧性心梗患者中，基于心脏磁共振晚期钆增强（LGE）图像计算的全局离散度评分（GDS）可独立预测恶性室性心律失常事件，尤其在LVEF>35%的患者中，其预测价值优于LGE范围和LVEF。
  • Postextrastimulus Termination of Ventricular Tachycardia: An Indicator of a Good Ablation Site?
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    本病例报告提示，心动过速时给予单个期外刺激可终止室速，可能提示消融靶点良好，但需仔细分析拖带反应以区分机制。
  • Electromechanical Window Negativity and Arrhythmic Risk in Arrhythmogenic Mitral Valve Prolapse.
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-20
    在致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂患者中，机电窗口（EMW）显著负向，且与持续性室性心律失常独立相关，可作为风险标志物。

器械治疗（2）

  • Failure of Implantable Cardioverter-defibrillator Pacing Capture in BRASH Syndrome with Severe Hyperkalemia.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    一例54岁终末期肾病合并心衰女性，因高钾血症（7.8 mEq/L）导致ICD起搏夺获失败，经降钾治疗和透析后恢复。
  • Subcutaneous versus transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-20

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Clinical spectrum and risk factors for severe arrhythmias in non-surgical pediatric patients: a single-center retrospective study.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-20
    单中心428例儿童心律失常回顾性研究显示，婴幼儿年龄、基础心脏病、晕厥史和心功能III-IV级是严重心律失常的独立危险因素，预测模型AUC达0.925。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Multimodal KCNQ1 Variant-Effect Maps Define Ion Channel Mechanisms and Disease Risk.
    Circulation · 2026-10-20
    研究对KCNQ1基因的13403个变异进行高通量功能评估，发现1757个变异有强致病证据，功能丧失变异与QT延长及长QT综合征显著相关，且多数致病变异通过显性负性效应增加心律失常风险。
  • Short- and long-term effects of dronedarone on Cav3.1- and Cav3.2-T-type calcium channel current.
    Eur J Histochem · 2026-10-20
    决奈达隆抑制T型钙通道，对Cav3.2亚型抑制作用更强（IC50 9.20 µM），慢性处理减慢通道动力学，并在心肌梗死模型中加重心肌损伤和纤维化。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Valvular Heart Disease: Assessing the Impact of Genetics in the UK Biobank.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-20
    在UK Biobank中，AF多基因风险评分可预测二尖瓣疾病患者的AF风险（尤其MVP），但对主动脉瓣疾病无显著预测价值，提示遗传贡献因VHD亚型而异。
  • Long-Term Outcome Following Idiopathic Ventricular Fibrillation and Potential Emerging Etiologies.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-20
    特发性室颤幸存者长期随访显示心脏死亡率低（1.2%），但心律失常复发率高达52.7%，且68.8%的患者在随访中明确或可能明确新病因，提示需持续监测与个体化管理。
  • Convergent Ferroptosis and Pyroptosis in MASLD-Associated Cardiac Remodeling.
    Transl Res · 2026-10-20
    本综述提出铁死亡与细胞焦亡可能是连接MASLD与心脏重构的共同调节性细胞死亡通路，但跨器官肝-心轴尚未在MASLD模型或患者中直接验证。

其他（1）

  • A Puzzling Supraventricular Rhythm: A Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenge.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-20

房颤与消融（12）

  • A Conservatively Managed Giant Ascending Aortic Aneurysm Presenting With New Atrial Fibrillation and Heart Failure.
    Cureus · 2026-10-20
    88岁女性新发房颤伴心衰，超声意外发现9.3cm升主动脉瘤，因高龄衰弱未手术，保守治疗并抗凝，2个月随访瘤体未增大。
  • Maintenance of atrial fibrillation by reciprocal triggering of competitive focal sources: a hypothesis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    该假说提出，房颤的维持可能源于多个竞争性局灶源（由延迟后除极相互触发）的周期性主导切换，而非完整折返，这为Cox-Maze和肺静脉隔离的成功提供了统一解释。

  • Single versus double transseptal puncture for atrial fibrillation radiofrequency ablation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

  • Efficacy, safety, and strategy-modifying factors of pulsed field ablation for persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    在持续性/长程持续性房颤中，PFA 12个月无房性心律失常复发率约66%-83%，对比冷冻球囊复发风险更低（RR 0.71），但证据确定性极低。

    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
    心脏术后早期，6分钟步行试验中的心脏做功（总心搏数/步行距离）可行，女性与更高做功独立相关，房颤与较低心率相关，虚弱与较短步行距离相关。
  • Long-Term Association Between Comprehensive Cardiac Rehabilitation and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Rhythm-Control Interventions.
    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
  • Pulsed Field Ablation for Cardiac Arrhythmias: Industry Landscape and US Food and Drug Administration-approved Platforms (2025).
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    综述指出PFA已从实验技术发展为房颤一线消融疗法，FDA批准的多种平台正推动其向局灶和混合消融策略演进。
  • Evaluation and Classification of Atrial Arrhythmias from Signatures in Electrographic Flow Metrics.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在151例房颤消融患者中，基于电解剖血流标测的失组织化评分和平均EGFC可区分AF、AFL和AT，多层感知器模型仅用五个指标即达81%准确率，且100%区分AF与更规则心律。
  • Impact of Frailty on Recurrence After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在房颤导管消融患者中，衰弱使房性快速性心律失常复发风险增加57%（RR 1.57），应纳入术前风险分层。
  • Atrial fibrillation in stroke patients: facts, numbers and current challenges.
    Neurol Res Pract · 2026-10-20
    房颤是缺血性卒中可干预的重要危险因素，20-30%卒中患者存在房颤；不同临床情境下抗凝策略需个体化，新治疗手段尚待随机对照试验验证。
  • Spanish catheter ablation registry. 25th official report of the Heart Rhythm Association of the Spanish Society of Cardiology (2025).
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-20
    2025年西班牙导管消融登记显示共完成33 435例消融，房颤仍是最常见适应证，脉冲场消融占比升至37%，急性成功率95%、并发症率1.6%、死亡率0.04%。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Late gadolinium enhancement dispersion mapping predicts major arrhythmic events in patients with prior myocardial infarction.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-20
    在既往心肌梗死患者中，LGE离散度标测（GDS）可独立预测恶性室性心律失常，尤其在LVEF>35%人群中优于LVEF和LGE范围。
  • Postextrastimulus Termination of Ventricular Tachycardia: An Indicator of a Good Ablation Site?
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    本病例报告提示，心动过速时给予单个期外刺激可终止室速，此现象可能提示消融靶点良好，但需谨慎解读其机制。
  • Electromechanical Window Negativity and Arrhythmic Risk in Arrhythmogenic Mitral Valve Prolapse.
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-20
    在致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂患者中，机电窗（EMW）显著负向，且对持续性室性心律失常具有独立预测价值，曲线下面积0.82，优于QTc和QAoCc。

器械治疗（2）

  • Failure of Implantable Cardioverter-defibrillator Pacing Capture in BRASH Syndrome with Severe Hyperkalemia.

    一例54岁终末期肾病合并心衰女性，因高钾血症（7.8 mEq/L）导致ICD起搏夺获失败，纠正高钾后恢复，提示BRASH综合征中代谢紊乱可逆性抑制心肌兴奋性。
  • Subcutaneous versus transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-20

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Clinical spectrum and risk factors for severe arrhythmias in non-surgical pediatric patients: a single-center retrospective study.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-20
    婴幼儿年龄、基础心脏病、晕厥史和心功能III-IV级是儿童严重心律失常的独立危险因素，预测模型AUC达0.925。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Multimodal KCNQ1 Variant-Effect Maps Define Ion Channel Mechanisms and Disease Risk.
    Circulation · 2026-10-20
    研究对KCNQ1基因的13403个变异进行高通量功能评估，发现1757个变异有强致病证据，功能丧失变异与QT延长及长QT综合征显著相关，且多数致病变异通过显性负性效应增加心律失常风险。
  • Short- and long-term effects of dronedarone on Cav3.1- and Cav3.2-T-type calcium channel current.
    Eur J Histochem · 2026-10-20
    决奈达隆浓度依赖性抑制T型钙通道，对Cav3.2（IC50 9.20 µM）的抑制作用约为Cav3.1（IC50 46.41 µM）的5倍，并在心梗模型中加重心肌损伤与纤维化。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Valvular Heart Disease: Assessing the Impact of Genetics in the UK Biobank.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-20

  • Long-Term Outcome Following Idiopathic Ventricular Fibrillation and Potential Emerging Etiologies.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-20
    特发性室颤幸存者长期随访显示心脏死亡率低（1.2%），但心律失常复发率持续累积达52.7%，且68.8%的患者在随访中明确了新病因，包括局灶源、微结构心肌改变和遗传性心律失常。

    Transl Res · 2026-10-20
    本综述提出铁死亡与细胞焦亡可能通过ACSL4/ALOX12/12-HETE/NLRP3轴在MASLD相关心脏重构中汇聚，但该通路尚未在MASLD模型或患者中直接验证。

item.title: 2026-10-19 心脏电生理日报（38 篇）
item.description:
共 38 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（22）

  • In-Hospital Mortality After Aortic Valve Replacement Surgical Versus Transcatheter: A Nationwide Study with Machine Learning-Based Risk Prediction.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-19
    基于美国全国再入院数据库的361,875例主动脉瓣置换患者分析显示，SAVR较TAVR院内死亡风险显著更高（OR 2.66，95%CI 2.51-2.81），但30天至6个月随访死亡率无差异。
  • Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation in adult patients admitted to an intensive care unit.
    Ann Intensive Care · 2026-10-19
    法国重症医学会基于GRADE方法制定成人ICU内房颤管理专家建议，共18条推荐，其中16条仅为专家意见，仅2条基于低级别证据。
  • Development and external validation of a 2-year mortality risk model for atrial fibrillation and heart failure with an online calculator
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-19
    本研究开发并外部验证了房颤合并心衰患者2年死亡风险预测模型，包含9个预测因子，区分度良好（AUC 0.848和0.862），并提供了在线计算器。
  • Prospective multicenter feasibility study of omnipolar near-field peak-frequency mapping for slow-pathway localization in typical atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-19
    在典型AVNRT患者中，基于OTNF的峰值频率标测可识别慢径消融靶区，90%有效消融点对应最高PF区，平均PF 424 Hz vs 周围272 Hz。
  • Echocardiography-derived Left Atrial Volumetric-Mechanical Coupling Index predicts early new-onset atrial fibrillation after embolic stroke/transient ischemic attack of undetermined source.
    Clin Res Cardiol · 2026-10-19
    在ESUS/TIA患者中，超声心动图衍生的LACI-VM可独立预测新发房颤，联合左室充盈压可识别极低危（约2%）与高危（约20%）亚组。
  • Initiation of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy and Lifestyle Modifications for Morbid Obesity in a Patient With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation, Severe Osteoarthritis, and Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Case Report
    Cureus · 2026-10-19
  • Determinants of outcome in atrial functional tricuspid regurgitation.
    Echo Res Pract · 2026-10-19
    在房颤相关功能性三尖瓣反流患者中，右房储备期应变降低是全因死亡的独立预测因子（校正HR 0.88），提示右房形变成像可用于风险分层。
  • Physical and psychological pathways associated with cognitive recovery following Baduanjin exercise combined with digital cognitive training in older adults with atrial fibrillation: A secondary mediation analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
    Eur J Cardiovasc Nurs · 2026-10-19
    在老年房颤患者中，八段锦联合数字认知训练改善认知功能，其效应部分通过改善躯体功能与减轻抑郁症状介导。
  • Adverse pregnancy outcomes as early indicators of long-term maternal atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol · 2026-10-19
    不良妊娠结局（尤其妊娠期高血压疾病和子痫前期）与母亲远期房颤风险升高相关，提示其可作为心律失常易感性的早期标志。
  • Diagnostic accuracy of wearable technologies for atrial fibrillation detection: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Global Cardiology · 2026-10-19
    可穿戴设备检测房颤诊断准确性优异，智能手机心电图设备表现最佳（敏感度94.5%，特异度95.8%）。
  • Temporal Changes in LGE-CMR Enhancement After Monopolar Biphasic Focal Pulsed Field Ablation for Pulmonary Vein Isolation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-19
    局灶点对点脉冲场消融行肺静脉隔离后，急性期LGE-CMR强化在90天随访时显著减退，且局限于肺静脉前庭及邻近后壁。
  • ROLE OF AMBULATORY HOLTER ELECTROCARDIOGRAPHIC MONITORING IN DETECTING ATRIAL FIBRILLATION IN PATIENTS WITH ISCHEMIC STROKE
    International Journal of Advanced Research · 2026-10-19
    在57例影像确诊的缺血性卒中且既往无房颤患者中，24–72小时动态Holter监测检出房颤的比例较低，摘要未报告具体检出率及关联因素。
  • Efficacy of prophylactic use of sotalol versus amiodarone in the prevention of new onset post operative atrial fibrillation post off pump coronary artery bypass surgery
    International Journal of Research in Medical Sciences · 2026-10-19
    在非体外循环冠脉搭桥患者中，预防性使用胺碘酮与索他洛尔术后房颤发生率相近（25% vs 27.77%），疗效相当，但索他洛尔费用显著更低。
  • Distinct hemodynamic implications of junctional rhythm versus sinus rhythm on cardiac reverse remodeling after the Maze procedure.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-19
    Maze术后交界性心律并非良性结局，其心脏逆重构和机械恢复与房颤相似，且起搏器植入风险显著高于窦性心律和房颤。
  • Identifying the electrically unstable NSTEMI patient: Comparative performance of four scores for short-term risk stratification of major cardiac arrhythmias.
    J Electrocardiol · 2026-10-19
    在485例NSTEMI患者中，11.3%发生主要心律失常，整合心衰、AKI、RBBB和血钠的模型预测心律失常的AUC为0.733，优于传统ACS评分，而GRACE 2.0对院内死亡预测最稳定。
  • Obesity and Atrial Fibrillation: Weighing the Evidence
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-19
    肥胖是房颤可干预危险因素，但单纯减重随机试验未显著改善房颤结局，GLP-1受体激动剂和综合生活方式干预展现潜力但缺乏以房颤为主要终点的证据。
  • Drug Therapies and Incident Heart Failure in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-19
    系统评价17项研究显示，仅ACTIVE-I预设亚组中厄贝沙坦与AF患者首次心衰住院减少相关（HR 0.81），其余药物证据多为观察性关联，无法证明因果。
  • Atrial fibrillation in stroke patients: facts, numbers and current challenges
    Neurol Res Pract · 2026-10-19
    房颤是缺血性卒中可干预的重要危险因素，20-30%的卒中患者存在房颤；不同临床情境下抗凝策略需个体化，亚临床房颤抗凝获益与出血风险并存，左心耳封堵等新疗法尚待随机试验验证。
  • Diagnostic Accuracy and Occupational Feasibility of AI-Enabled Smartwatches for Atrial Fibrillation Detection Among Active Workers: A Systematic Review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-19
    该系统评价未检索到在职业人群中直接验证智能手表房颤检测算法的研究，现有算法准确性证据均来自非工作场景，且运动伪差导致的不可判读记录对真实世界准确性的影响尚不明确。
  • PRIMARY PREVENTION OF CARDIOEMBOLIC STROKE IN ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND THE ROLE OF ANTICOAGULANT THERAPY
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-19
    该论文综述指出，房颤是心源性卒中的主要危险因素，个体化血栓栓塞风险评估与直接口服抗凝药是房颤患者一级预防的核心策略。
  • INSPIRE noncardiac surgery POAF analysis code collection
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-19
    该存档提供R脚本用于研究非心脏手术后房颤，但未包含患者数据或模型，且未验证代码可复现原结果。
  • Temporal Patterns of Arrhythmia and Conduction Disorder Diagnoses After Infective Endocarditis
    medRxiv · 2026-10-19
    感染性心内膜炎患者出院后31-365天新发心律失常/传导障碍风险较菌血症对照升高73%，以31-90天风险最高（HR 2.41），但1年绝对风险差仅2.84个百分点。

室性心律失常（6）

  • Occult cardiac diffuse large B-cell lymphoma masquerading as electrical storm and diagnosed after urgent heart transplantation: a rare case report
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-19
    46岁女性以难治性电风暴和心源性休克起病，紧急心脏移植后病理确诊为心脏弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤，术后迅速死亡。
  • Palpitations in children and adolescents in the emergency department: a state-of-the-art narrative review of arrhythmia risk, diagnostic strategy, and disposition.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-19
    儿童心悸多为良性，通过病史、体检和12导联心电图识别“红旗”特征可有效分层，低危者可安全离院，高危者需紧急评估。
  • Pathological cardiac changes associated with recreational drug-related sudden cardiac death: a systematic review
    Egyptian Journal of Forensic Sciences · 2026-10-19
    系统综述纳入18项研究，发现娱乐性药物相关猝死尸检中最常见的心脏病理为心脏增大，其次为心肌纤维化，不同药物对应不同病理谱。
  • High-Frequency Electrograms Abolition as a Valuable Target for Remap During Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation. The HF REMAP Study.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-19
    在43例室速消融患者中，消融后残余高频电图负荷<70%者12个月无室速生存率约90%，显著高于≥70%者的约25%，残余高频负荷≥70%是复发的独立预测因子。
  • Integration of an echocardiographic motion-management system into photon-based stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation planning.
    Phys Imaging Radiat Oncol · 2026-10-19
    在光子立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）计划中，将超声探头置于主束外（心尖或胸骨旁）可控制探头受照剂量（D0.035 cm³<1 Gy），靶区剂量体积参数无显著差异，但适形指数轻度下降，整体计划质量仍在临床可接受范围内。
  • Narrow Is Slow: CT-Derived Anatomic Isthmus 3 Width and Arrhythmogenic Substrate in Repaired Tetralogy of Fallot
    medRxiv · 2026-10-19
    在修复法洛四联症成人中，CT测量的解剖峡部3宽度较窄（≤21.5 mm）与电生理检查中慢传导峡部3相关，可辅助无创风险分层。

器械治疗（1）

  • [Positive communication during pacemaker implantation in local anesthesia : Results of an interdisciplinary task force comprising a psychotherapist, German linguist and cardiac surgeon].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-10-19
    在局麻下植入起搏器时，正向沟通可减轻患者应激，但当前缺乏相关培训与意识；本文由心理治疗师、语言学家和心脏外科医生合作，基于2022年著作提供实践建议。

遗传与基础（7）

  • Unmasking Brugada Syndrome With Oral Propafenone in a Resource-Limited Setting: A Case Report.
    Cureus · 2026-10-19
    24岁不明原因晕厥男性，基线心电图呈2型Brugada模式，因资源有限改用单次口服普罗帕酮600 mg激发试验，第3小时诱发出1型Brugada心电图，确诊Brugada综合征，无并发症。
  • Family screening for genetic cardiomyopathies in ECG-positive phenotype-negative adolescents: a joint clinical and genetic approach.
    Eur J Pediatr · 2026-10-19
    在ECG阳性但表型阴性的青少年中，约1/5的亲属存在心肌病诊断或早期心肌病特征，联合临床-遗传筛查可提高诊断率。
  • Beyond Conventional Autopsy: Recent Advances in Molecular Autopsy for Sudden Cardiac Death Investigation
    Genes · 2026-10-19
    分子尸检通过死后基因检测识别遗传性心肌病和离子通道病致病突变，在常规尸检阴性的心脏性猝死中明确病因并筛查高危亲属。
  • Enhancing Heart Disease Prediction through Multi-Modal Data Integration: A Hybrid CNN-GA Approach
    International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology · 2026-10-19
    基于MIT-BIH数据库，CNN-GA混合模型对ECG心搏分类准确率达98.21%，显著优于基线CNN和预训练模型（p=0.03）。
  • An implantable optoelectronic platform for untethered, automated, and shock-free optogenetic termination of ventricular tachycardia in rodents
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-19
    该研究报道一种可植入光电平台，在啮齿类动物中实现无束缚、自动、无电击的光遗传学终止室性心动过速。
  • Non-Equilibrium Biophysics, Conformational Genetics, and Bio-Inspired Energy Materials: Bi-Helmholtz Continuum Regularization, Hierarchical Haar Wavelets, and Excitable Lienard Pacemakers in Lean 4
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-19
    该摘要为Lean 4形式化数学证明，未涉及临床心脏电生理研究，无法提供患者导向的结论。
  • Reciprocal repression between Isl1 and Nkx2-5 defines the zebrafish embryonic cardiac pacemaker domain
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-10-19
    斑马鱼胚胎中Isl1通过抑制Nkx2-5维持静脉极起搏细胞身份，isl1缺失导致起搏细胞腔室化及严重心动过缓，而Shox2并非必需。

其他（2）

  • Twenty Years at the Crossroads: Is Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology Science, Procedure, or Both?
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-19
  • Ambulatory Electrocardiography Modalities in Pediatric Arrhythmia Detection and Management.
    JAMA Pediatr · 2026-10-19
    在435例无结构性心脏病的儿童中，7天连续动态心电图监测对主要心律失常的检出率（6.2%）显著高于24小时Holter和7天事件记录器（均2.3%），且灵敏度更高（73% vs 27%），并更多触发临床管理改变（7.1% vs 1.6%和2.8%）。

item.title: 2026-10-18 心脏电生理日报（20 篇）
item.description:
共 20 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（6）

  • Growing Cardiopulmonary Challenge: National Mortality Trends of Pulmonary Vascular Disease and Atrial Fibrillation In the United States
    2026-10-18
  • Heart failure and atrial fibrillation prediction from non-gated chest CT scans using AI-based cardiac chamber volumetry: an AI-CVD study within the multi-ethnic study of atherosclerosis (MESA).
    Am J Prev Cardiol · 2026-10-18
    基于AI的非门控胸部CT心脏腔室容积测量与门控CT高度一致，对心衰和房颤的预测性能非劣效，可用于机会性筛查。
  • Determinants of outcome in atrial functional tricuspid regurgitation
    Echo Research and Practice · 2026-10-18
    在房颤相关功能性三尖瓣反流患者中，右房储器应变降低是全因死亡的独立预测因素（校正HR 0.88，95%CI 0.81-0.95，P<0.001）。
  • GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-18
    在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中，GLP-1RA治疗与1年新发AF风险降低34.5%相关，且持续至3年。
  • Artificial intelligence versus conventional risk scores for predicting incident atrial fibrillation: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-18
    本研究方案拟系统评价与荟萃分析，比较人工智能模型与传统风险评分对成人新发房颤的预测区分度、校准度及增量价值。
  • Projected Failure Margins in Biological Chaos: Cardiac Arrhythmias and Neural Dynamics as Thickening
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-18
    该文将可达性框架应用于生物混沌控制，以心搏间期投影定义失败集，提出正的无控制裕量在缓冲带反馈下得以保持，但未提供新数据或临床优势。

室性心律失常（4）

  • Recurrent Supraventricular Tachycardia Triggered by Tea Consumption in a Postoperative Adolescent Female: A Case Report.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-18
    一例16岁术后女性饮茶后反复发作室上性心动过速（心率170次/分），静脉腺苷可恢复窦性心律，提示饮食性刺激物可作为SVT诱因。
  • Blocking the Sympathetic Storm: Adjunctive Left Stellate Ganglion Block for Refractory Ventricular Tachycardia After Inferolateral Myocardial Infarction
    Cureus · 2026-10-18
    53岁下侧壁心梗后反复单形性室速电风暴患者，在药物与电复律无效后经超声引导左星状神经节阻滞，室速随即终止并出现Horner征，24小时内拔管。
  • Stellate ganglion block for ventricular arrhythmia disease states: Emerging treatment options.
    J Anesth Transl Med · 2026-10-18
    星状神经节阻滞（SGB）作为微创自主神经调节手段，在病例系列和观察性研究中可短期减少室性心律失常负荷并终止电风暴，但缺乏随机对照证据。
  • Rapid Progression of Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy With Sudden Cardiac Death Within the First Year of Heart Transplantation: A Case Report.
    Transplant Proc · 2026-10-18
    56岁男性心脏移植后5个月出现非典型胸痛，12个月冠脉造影示ISHLT CAV-3弥漫三支病变，尽管LVEF保留仍发生多形性室速并接受WCD放电，提示CAV快速进展可致梗死和心律失常。

心力衰竭与代谢（4）

  • External validation of artificial intelligence-guided electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) in detecting asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Am J Prev Cardiol · 2026-10-18
    在无症状左室收缩功能不全人群中，外部验证的AI-ECG检测LVEF≤40%的汇总AUROC达0.93，与有症状心衰人群表现相当，但异质性高、偏倚风险大。
  • Validation studies of ICD-10 diagnostic codes for identifying common causes of hospitalization: a scoping review.
    J Clin Epidemiol · 2026-10-18
    ICD-10诊断编码验证研究在设计、病例定义和报告上高度异质，多数仅报告阳性预测值，需标准化人群研究同时评估灵敏度和特异度。
  • ICD-Coded Versus Undiagnosed Acute Kidney Injury in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) Study.
    Kidney Med · 2026-10-18
    在ARIC队列中，ICD编码仅识别51.4%的基于肌酐的AKI，未诊断AKI在女性中更常见，且与ICD编码AKI具有相似的临床风险因素、蛋白质组和代谢组特征，并与冠心病、心衰、卒中和死亡强相关。
  • Doxorubicin-induced Cardiotoxicity in Dogs: A Narrative Review.
    Vet Comp Oncol · 2026-10-18
    多柔比星在犬中可致急慢性心脏毒性，机制涉及氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍等，现有证据多来自实验和回顾性研究，亟需大型前瞻性临床研究。

影像与标测（1）

  • Comparison of AI-enabled cardiac chambers volumetry based on non-gated chest CT scans with echocardiography: An AI-CVD study within the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA).
    Am J Prev Cardiol · 2026-10-18

遗传与基础（4）

  • Structured postmortem genetic counselling and testing in sudden unexplained death among young adults in the Netherlands: results and implications regarding hereditary risk.
    J Community Genet · 2026-10-18
    荷兰年轻成人不明原因猝死中，结构化尸检后基因检测在46例中检出6例致病变异，支持对存活亲属进行遗传评估与筛查。
  • Optogenetic cardioversion: To depolarize or to hyperpolarize?
    J Physiol · 2026-10-18
  • Channelrhodopsin ion selectivity determines mechanisms and efficacy of optogenetic defibrillation in human atria and ventricles.
    J Physiol · 2026-10-18
    计算模拟比较ChR2、GtACR1和WiChR的光遗传除颤效果，发现GtACR1在低光强下最有效，WiChR在高光强下效果相当且钙超载风险更低，离子选择性决定除颤机制与安全性。
  • Pathogenic Variants in NKX2-5 Associated With Familial Atrial Septal Defect and Conduction System Disease.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-18
    一个三代家系中，新型NKX2-5致病性变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75）与常染色体显性遗传的房间隔缺损及传导系统疾病共分离。

其他（1）

  • A hybrid quantum algorithm for multi-resolution arrhythmia classification
    Scientific Reports · 2026-10-18
    混合量子算法在112像素低分辨率下ECG心律失常六分类平均准确率0.9690，优于ResNet50的0.9396，但优势随分辨率与随机种子变化不一致。

item.title: 2026-10-17 心脏电生理日报（30 篇）
item.description:
共 30 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（15）

  • Investigating Factors Associated with the Occurrence of Atrial Fibrillation after Non-cardiothoracic Surgery.
    Adv Biomed Res · 2026-10-17
    非心胸外科手术后48.1%患者发生房颤，既往胸部手术、心衰、高血压等是显著危险因素。
  • Initiation of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy and Lifestyle Modifications for Morbid Obesity in a Patient With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation, Severe Osteoarthritis, and Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Case Report.
    Cureus · 2026-10-17
    一例57岁病态肥胖合并阵发性房颤、严重膝骨关节炎和阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者，经GLP-1受体激动剂联合生活方式干预12个月，BMI从2级降至1级肥胖，血压和血脂改善。
  • GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-17
    在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中，GLP-1RA治疗与1年房颤新发风险降低34.5%相关，且效应持续至3年。
  • Predictive modeling for warfarin efficacy: A risk stratification tool for INR stabilization in atrial fibrillation
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Who bleeds and who doesn't? – Complex older persons on direct oral anticoagulants for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Atrial fibrillation burden and episode duration on ambulatory Holter monitoring: Clinical correlates and diagnostic yield in a single-centre experience and observation
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Comparative procedural efficiency, safety and mid-term recurrence outcomes of pulsed field, cryoballoon and radiofrequency ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: A 15-year single centre real-world experience
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Switching warfarin to direct oral anticoagulation (DOAC) in adult patient with non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) in INR Clinic, Medical Department Hospital Kuala Lumpur: A budget impact analysis (BIA)
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Totally Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation With the Gemini S Bipolar Clamp: A Single-Center Descriptive Cohort Study of 1-Year Rhythm, Safety, and Quality-of-Life Outcomes.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-17
    全胸腔镜下使用Gemini S双极钳行心外膜盒式隔离联合左心耳排除，23例房颤患者1年窦性心律维持率87.0%，但13.0%因出血中转开胸。
  • Localized bigeminal activity in the left atrial posterior wall preceding atrial fibrillation initiation.
    J Cardiol Cases · 2026-10-17
    本病例报告发现左心房后壁低电压区附近存在局限性二联律活动，可先于房颤发作出现，针对该部位消融并连接至邻近低电压区后实现房颤持久消除。
  • Successful superior vena cava isolation using point-by-point cryothermal ablation after failed radiofrequency ablation.
    J Cardiol Cases · 2026-10-17
    76岁阵发性房颤患者，在射频消融无法实现上腔静脉隔离后，采用逐点冷冻消融成功完成上腔静脉隔离且无并发症。
  • Sinus arrest during right pulmonary vein isolation related to right sinus node artery injury: a case report.
    J Cardiol Cases · 2026-10-17
    50岁长程持续性房颤患者行右肺静脉前庭射频消融时，第二刀即引发窦性停搏，需右室起搏3分钟恢复，回顾分析证实消融部位邻近右窦房结动脉，提示术前评估窦房结动脉并保持窦性心律下消融有助于早期识别和预防不可逆损伤。
  • Absence of arrhythmogenic effects in cAMP subcellular compartments supports PDE8 as a target in atrial fibrillation.
    J Mol Cell Cardiol Plus · 2026-10-17
    在141例房颤与窦律患者心房肌细胞中，全PDE8抑制未增加胞浆、RyR2、肌节纳米域cAMP水平，也未诱发致心律失常性钙火花或钙波，支持PDE8作为房颤靶点。
  • What is the mechanism of atrial flutter?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-17
    典型心房扑动主要由右心房大折返环路驱动，环路通常经过三尖瓣峡部，心房结构重构与电重构参与其病理生理过程。
  • Enhancing energy delivery does not remove the acutely blocked but surviving margin: a unified biophysical analysis of radiofrequency, cryo and pulsed field ablation in myocardial walls of different thickness
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-17
    射频、冷冻和脉冲场消融在心肌壁中均产生急性电静默但存活的边缘带，增强能量策略仅改变其位置或宽度而非消除，壁厚和消融间距决定其是否成为传导恢复通路。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Incidentally Detected Supraventricular Tachycardia in a Preterm Neonate: A Case Report of Successful Medical Management and Follow-up
    International Journal of Medical and Pharmaceutical Case Reports · 2026-10-17
    一例2周大中度早产男婴发现持续性室上性心动过速（心率250-260 bpm），经迷走刺激、腺苷及口服普萘洛尔治疗后心率稳定，6个月时停药并恢复窦性心律。
  • Seizures Secondary to Aconitum Plant Poisoning: a case report.
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-10-17
    一例53岁男性饮用草乌酒后先出现室速/室颤致心源性晕厥，复苏后第4-6天出现全面性强直-阵挛发作，脑电图证实为中枢神经毒性所致真性癫痫。
  • Rapid Progression of Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy With Sudden Cardiac Death Within the First Year of Heart Transplantation: A Case Report
    Transplant Proc · 2026-10-17
    56岁男性心脏移植后5个月出现非典型胸痛，12个月冠脉造影示ISHLT CAV-3弥漫三支病变，LVEF保留下发生多形性室速并接受WCD放电，提示CAV可快速进展致心律失常和猝死。

器械治疗（4）

  • Severe Hypothyroidism Causing Reversible Pacing Failure: A Case Report and Literature Review
    Cureus · 2026-10-17
    66岁女性因严重甲状腺功能减退导致起搏器感知和起搏功能异常，甲状腺激素替代治疗后起搏器功能恢复正常。
  • Pacing-induced cardiomyopathy: Prevalence, time course, predictors, and device-specific risk in leadless versus transvenous pacemakers – A 10-year real-world experience from a Southeast Asian National Heart Centre
    International Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-17
  • Pediatric restrictive cardiomyopathy with rapid complete atrioventricular block progression.
    J Cardiol Cases · 2026-10-17
    7岁限制型心肌病患儿从一度房室传导阻滞快速进展为完全性房室传导阻滞，病理证实传导系统广泛纤维化，起搏器联合药物治疗成功桥接至心脏移植。
  • A misleading wide-complex rhythm in an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator recipient.
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-16

心力衰竭与代谢（2）

  • Validation studies of ICD-10 diagnostic codes for identifying common causes of hospitalization: a scoping review
    J Clin Epidemiol · 2026-10-17
    针对8种常见住院病因的ICD-10诊断编码验证研究在设计、病例定义和报告上高度异质，超过三分之一仅报告阳性预测值，无法全面评估效度，亟需标准化的基于人群的验证研究同时测量灵敏度和特异度。
  • Development and Population-Based Prognostic Utility Assessment of an ICD-10-CM-Based Prediction Model to Identify Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction: Discrimination Performance and Population-Based Evaluation in 83,357 Patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-17
    基于ICD-10-CM代码和两项临床变量构建的LVEF降低预测模型在83,357例ACS患者中区分度中等（AUC 0.738），预测LVEF降低与全因死亡风险升高2.45倍相关。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Cellular consequences of non-ablative radiotherapy, a novel approach to ventricular tachycardias
    Europace · 2026-10-17
    小鼠在体单次放疗（25 Gy）可增强心肌细胞钠电流（尤其持续成分）并延长动作电位时程，但抑制钙处理、增加ROS，提示STAR抑制室速的同时可能损害电稳定性和收缩力。
  • Endocardial thickening in dilated cardiomyopathy associated with FHL2 variant: a case report.
    Front Genet · 2026-10-17
    30天龄男婴携带FHL2新发错义变异c.391C>T，表现为左室扩大、LVEF低至13%及心内膜增厚，6个月随访LVEF仍仅15.5%，提示该变异与早发重症DCM相关。
  • Successful extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation in a patient with short QT syndrome: A case report.
    J Cardiol Cases · 2026-10-17
    一例20余岁男性短QT综合征患者经复苏后，因高T波导致皮下ICD筛查失败，成功植入血管外ICD。
  • Channelrhodopsin ion selectivity determines mechanisms and efficacy of optogenetic defibrillation in human atria and ventricles
    J Physiol · 2026-10-17
    计算模拟比较ChR2、GtACR1和WiChR光遗传除颤：GtACR1低光强最有效，WiChR≥5 mW/mm²时疗效相当且Ca²⁺累积最小，离子选择性决定疗效与机制。
  • Catheter Ablation of Drug-refractory Ventricular Tachycardia in Genetically Confirmed Carvajal Syndrome with Extensive Left Ventricular Scar: A Case Report
    SN Comprehensive Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-17

其他（1）

  • Astrocytes at the interface of peri-ictal breathing dysfunction and SUDEP.
    Front Netw Physiol · 2026-10-17
    星形胶质细胞通过钾和谷氨酸稳态失衡、炎症及脑干呼吸中枢功能障碍参与癫痫围发作期呼吸衰竭与SUDEP，药物抑制星形胶质细胞活化可延迟缺氧诱导的癫痫和呼吸停止。

item.title: 2026-10-16 心脏电生理日报（72 篇）
item.description:
共 72 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（35）

  • Rivaroxaban Is No Better Than Aspirin After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation at Least 1 Year Earlier.
    Am Fam Physician · 2026-10-16
  • Active Helicobacter pylori Infection and Atrial Fibrillation in Patients Hospitalized With Acute Myocardial Infarction.
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-10-16
    在310例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，幽门螺杆菌呼气试验阳性率20%，阳性者房颤记录比例反而更低（6.7% vs 12.5%），校正后无统计学显著关联。
  • When is percutaneous left atrial appendage closure a valid alternative to oral anticoagulation in atrial fibrillation?
    Bleeding Thrombosis and Vascular Biology · 2026-10-16
    三项近期随机试验（OPTION、CLOSURE-AF、CHAMPION-AF）探讨经皮左心耳封堵能否作为房颤患者口服抗凝的替代方案，摘要未报告具体结果。
  • Association Between Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI) and Glycemic Control (HbA1c) in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
  • Intravascular Hemolysis and the Spectrum of Tissue Injury Following Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review of Clinical Markers, Catheter Designs, and Renal Outcomes
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
  • Association Between Admission Calculated Serum Osmolality and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Non-ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Undergoing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention
    Diagnostics · 2026-10-16
    在行PCI的NSTEMI患者中，入院计算血清渗透压升高与新发房颤独立相关，但增量预测价值有限。
  • Atrial Cardiomyopathy in Patients with Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome: Non-Invasive Characterization (ATRIO-CKM).
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    ATRIO-CKM研究方案拟在CKM综合征各期中用常规心电、超声及生物标志物无创刻画心房心肌病，估计其分期患病率并筛选最强关联参数。
  • Echocardiographic Framework for Left Atrial Appendage Morphology Assessment and Thromboembolic Risk Stratification in Atrial Fibrillation.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    基于深度学习的LAATF框架在240例房颤患者中分类左心耳形态准确率91-94%，血栓检测AUC 0.935，并构建与结局强相关的血栓栓塞风险指数。
  • Same-Day Discharge Versus Overnight Stay After Catheter Ablation: An Observational Matched-Cohort Study on Safety and Feasibility
    Dtsch Arztebl Int · 2026-10-16
    在选择性电生理消融患者中，同日出院（SDD）与过夜留院（ONS）的围术期并发症及30天再入院率无显著差异，85.8%的预定SDD患者成功当日出院。
  • Atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming in atrial fibrillation: a candidate mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-16
  • Asymmetric biphasic pulsed field ablation of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: clinical assessment
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-16
    新型不对称双相脉冲场消融系统可实现急性完全肺静脉隔离，12个月无房性心律失常复发率69.5%，安全性良好，无严重并发症及溶血相关肾损伤。
  • Translational maturity of artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography varies across cardiovascular diseases
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-16
    AI-ECG在STEMI分诊和低LVEF筛查中转化最成熟，而房颤预测、瓣膜病和心肌淀粉样变等领域仍处于验证阶段。
  • Latent class analysis-derived patterns of comorbidities in patients with atrial fibrillation, adherence to integrated care and impact on long-term outcomes: an analysis from a prospective cohort.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    在1233例房颤患者中，潜在类别分析识别出4种共病表型，其不良结局风险不同，而整合照护依从性与较低风险相关且各表型间无异质性。
  • Stroke Risk-Based Anticoagulation After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: ALONE-AF Post-Hoc Analysis.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    ALONE-AF事后分析显示，按CHA2DS2-VASc分层后，房颤消融后停用OAC与继续OAC在2年卒中/栓塞/大出血复合终点上无显著差异，但事件数有限。
  • Steatotic liver disease phenotypes and stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation: A nationwide population-based cohort study.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    在房颤患者中，酒精相关脂肪性肝病表型（MetALD和ALD）与缺血性卒中风险升高相关，而MASLD与卒中风险无关。
  • Association of Air Pollution Exposure and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation: The Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    在多种族动脉粥样硬化研究中，长期NO2暴露每升高一个四分位间距（13.5 ppb）与房颤发生风险增加29%相关（HR 1.29，95%CI 1.00-1.67）。
  • Unipolar Electrograms at the Pulmonary Vein Antrum: Spatial and Directional Heterogeneity with Distinct Postablation Morphologies.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    房颤射频消融中，肺静脉前庭单极电图存在空间和方向异质性，消融后S波振幅降低但18.1%位点残留负向波，14.7%位点新出现正向波，提示单极电图解读需考虑远场成分。
  • Characteristics of patients with obesity presenting with cardiac arrest and the potential role of cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an analysis using the National Inpatient Sample database.
    J Cardiovasc Med (Hagerstown) · 2026-10-16
    在肥胖住院患者中，心脏骤停者多为白人男性且合并症负担重，房颤与心脏骤停独立强相关（OR 7.80），社会经济地位高者更易接受ICD。
  • Hemodynamic and Metabolic Predictors of Unsuccessful Electrical Cardioversion or Early Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Electrical Cardioversion.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在持续性房颤患者中，电复律后30天内45.7%未能达到或维持窦性心律，T2DM和较高的TFC是独立预测因素，而高血压与较低风险相关。
  • Evaluation of Intraprocedural Strategies to Assess Acute Pulmonary Vein Isolation After First-Pass Wide Antral Circumferential Ablation.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在首次宽环周消融后，仅用肺静脉起搏评估左侧肺静脉及左carina的急性隔离可靠性不足，假阴性率显著高于三维电解剖重标测，右侧则无显著差异。
  • Thromboembolic and Mortality Risk in Patients with Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft-The TRIP-AF Study.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在CABG术后心脏康复患者中，术后房颤发生率为34.3%，单因素分析中与全因死亡和非致死性卒中的复合终点相关，但多因素分析中并非独立预测因素。
  • Safety, Efficacy, and Effectiveness of Pulsed Field Ablation with Farapulse™ to Treat Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Single-center Study
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-16
  • Transient Ischemic Attack Due to Delamination of a Steerable Guiding Sheath: A Potential Complication During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-16
  • Ablation in Dextrocardia With Interrupted Inferior Vena Cava and Azygos Continuation to Coronary Sinus.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    一例58岁男性右位心合并下腔静脉中断、奇静脉延续至冠状静脉窦的阵发性房颤患者，经左颈内静脉上腔途径、ICE引导下导丝房间隔穿刺，安全完成射频肺静脉隔离及顶部线消融。
  • Pregnancy-Related Right Atrial Appendage Tachycardia Requiring ECMO and Hybrid Ablation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    22岁孕妇36周发生右心耳起源房速，快速进展为心动过速性心肌病（EF 18%）并心源性休克，经VA-ECMO支持及杂交消融（胸腔镜双极射频）成功恢复窦律。
  • Durability and Safety of Superior Vena Cava Isolation With a Lattice-Tip Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: Focal Versus Circumferential Lesion Sets.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Machine Learning Integration of Ablation Quality Metrics for Predicting Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Multicenter Study.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
    多中心回顾性研究显示，整合消融质量指标的XGBoost模型可有效预测房颤消融术后1年复发，外部验证AUC达0.951-0.992。
  • Assessment of Direct Oral Anticoagulant Plasma Concentrations Before Elective Electrical Cardioversion
    Medicina · 2026-10-16
    37例房颤患者择期电复律前随机时点DOAC血药浓度变异明显，27.0%超过预期峰浓度上限，5.4%低于谷浓度下限，并发现2例肾功能已达标却未减量的用药错误。
  • Atrial cardiomyopathy: from knowledge gaps to clinical impact : The role of the EmbRACE Network.
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-16
    EmbRACE 网络提出整合基础、计算与临床试验的多学科框架，旨在将心房心肌病从理论概念转化为可临床操作的实体，以改善房颤风险分层与靶向治疗。
  • Statistical analysis plan for Dietary intake of omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids and risk of atrial fibrillation: A systematic review and meta-analysis
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-16
    本研究计划通过系统评价与荟萃分析，合并观察性研究中omega-3和omega-6脂肪酸摄入与房颤风险的关联，主要效应量为最高 versus 最低摄入的HR，采用随机效应模型。
  • Cardioneurology and neurocardiology are two sides of the same problem
    Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics · 2026-10-16
    本文为叙述性综述，阐述心脑双向轴中卒中相关心脏改变与心源性脑血管风险，强调跨学科整合对双器官保护的意义。
  • KDM-Net: a large-kernel and bi-mamba integrated network for 12-lead atrial arrhythmia classification.
    Physiol Meas · 2026-10-16
    KDM-Net模型在12导联心电图上区分房颤与房扑，独立患者测试集准确率96.41%、F1 88.31%，外部测试集准确率91.14%。
  • Splenic infarction associated with persistent atrial fibrillation: A case report
    World Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-16
    56岁男性持续性房颤抗凝不足患者，以急性左上腹痛为首发表现，确诊脾梗死，治疗性抗凝后症状迅速缓解。
  • CARDIORENAL RISK IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE IN ARID REGIONS
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-16
    综述指出房颤与慢性肾病应作为相互依赖的疾病管理，热暴露在干旱地区可能增加风险但证据不足，AI预测模型需透明且外部验证。
  • Trends and Disparities in Respiratory Failure Mortality with Co-Listed Atrial Fibrillation and Flutter Among U.S. Adults Aged ≥ 65 Years, 1999 to 2024, with AAMR Forecasts Through 2035: A CDC Wonder Analysis
    medRxiv · 2026-10-16
    美国≥65岁成人中，呼吸衰竭与房颤/房扑共列死亡年龄调整死亡率从1999年12.8升至2024年66.7/10万，预计2035年达122.96/10万，存在性别、种族、地区和城乡差异。

室性心律失常（14）

  • Recurrent Supraventricular Tachycardia Triggered by Tea Consumption in a Postoperative Adolescent Female: A Case Report
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    一例16岁术后女性饮茶后反复发作室上性心动过速（心率170次/分），静脉腺苷复律成功，提示膳食咖啡因可作为SVT诱因。
  • Angry Purkinje Syndrome: A Review of Short-Coupled Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia with Quinidine Treatment.
    Heart Lung Circ · 2026-10-16
    急性心梗血运重建后2-8天出现的短联律间期多形性室速（Angry Purkinje综合征）对常规抗心律失常药无效，奎尼丁可有效抑制。
  • Practical Approaches to Coronary Venous Ethanol Ablation for Refractory Ventricular Arrhythmias: Technique Selection and Clinical Outcomes.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    对心内膜射频消融无效的难治性室性心律失常患者，冠状静脉乙醇消融急性成功率高，长期随访约半数有效，无致命并发症。
  • Sparse-EWI: Towards an automated and real time focal arrhythmia mapping technique - in silico to clinical validation.
    IEEE Trans Ultrason · 2026-10-16
    稀疏EWI仅需每视图15个种子点即可自动估计激活时间，在仿真、犬和PVC患者中保持与常规EWI相当的定位精度，处理速度提升约5倍。
  • Arrhythmias in patients with transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis and the impact of contemporary disease-modifying therapies.
    J Cardiovasc Med (Hagerstown) · 2026-10-16
    本综述系统梳理转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变（ATTR-CM）相关心律失常的机制、流行病学与管理，并探讨新型疾病修饰治疗对心律失常负荷的潜在影响。
  • Predictive Value of the Electrical Risk Score for Ventricular Arrhythmias in Heart Failure Patients with Primary Prevention Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在91例心衰一级预防ICD患者中，电风险评分（ERS）≥3分与室性心律失常相关ICD电击独立相关，AUC达0.882，优于多数传统心电图指标。
  • Global Advances in Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-16
  • Seizures Secondary to Aconitum Plant Poisoning: a case report
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    一例53岁男性饮用草乌酒后先出现室速/室颤致心源性晕厥，后经脑电图证实出现真正癫痫发作，提示乌头碱中毒存在从心脏毒性到中枢神经毒性的动态演变。
  • Successful Guidewire-Guided Ethanol Ablation for PVCs Originating From Epicardial Anterior Interventricular Groove Adjacent to LAD.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    30岁男性高负荷起源于心外膜前室间沟邻近LAD的PVC，经导丝辅助无水乙醇消融成功，术后无冠脉损伤，2个月随访无复发。
  • Tachycardia Initiation by Dual-Mode PVC on Ambulatory ECG: Pattern Discovery and Invasive Electrophysiological Characteristics.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    57岁男性动态心电图显示同一形态PVC触发800阵长RP心动过速，两种起始模式经电生理检查证实为慢-慢型房室结折返性心动过速，消融成功。
  • Oscillatory Epicardial Delayed Potentials and Associated Unipolar Voltage Gradients in Brugada Syndrome.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Intravenous verapamil as salvage therapy for reperfusion-related refractory electrical storm following acute inferior myocardial infarction: a case report
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-16
    一例52岁急性下壁心梗PCI术后反复电风暴患者，常规治疗无效，静脉维拉帕米5mg成功转复并维持窦律。
  • Prevalence and clinical predictors of myocardial injury in patients with acute supraventricular tachycardia
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-16
    急性室上性心动过速患者中约半数出现高敏肌钙蛋白T升高，血清肌酐、初始心率和SVT发作至就诊时间是独立预测因素。
  • Forensic cause-of-death determination of myocardial infarction-related sudden cardiac death in histopathologically similar cases using computational pathology.
    Leg Med (Tokyo) · 2026-10-16
    计算病理学框架（UNI-CLAM）在组织学高度相似的心肌标本中区分心梗相关心源性猝死与其他死因，外部验证AUC 0.829，并识别出特征性心肌损伤模式。

器械治疗（7）

  • Correlative and Live-Cell Imaging of S100B-Promoter-Associated Interstitial Cells from the Cardiac Sinoatrial Node and Valves.
    Cells · 2026-10-16
    对S100B-EGFP报告小鼠窦房结和房室瓣间质细胞的探索性成像显示，EGFP+细胞形态异质，NAD(P)H自发荧光更高而TMRM信号更低，并观察到线粒体样结构经细胞间桥转移等候选事件。
  • Evolution of Tined Leadless Pacemaker Implantation: Patient Selection, Implant Volume, Center Characteristics, and Safety Trends.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    在46,698例Medicare患者中，带齿无导线起搏器植入的心脏穿孔率随时间下降，且高植入量术者穿孔率更低，结局变异更多归因于术者而非机构。
  • Functional Mitral Regurgitation Trajectories in CRT-Treated HFrEF During Medical Therapy Optimization: Association with Reverse Remodeling.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在接受CRT的HFrEF患者中启动沙库巴曲缬沙坦后，62%的患者功能性二尖瓣反流改善，且与左室射血分数提升、左室舒张末期容积和左房容积缩小相关。
  • First-in-Human Permanent Totally Leadless Left Ventricular Septal Endocardial Pacing With Atrioventricular Synchrony.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    首例人体完全无导线双腔起搏联合超声介导左室间隔心内膜起搏，通过心房起搏脉冲触发左室起搏实现房室顺序同步，QRS 142 ms。
  • First-in-Human Axillary Vein Implantation of a Leadless Pacemaker: Breaking the Access Barrier.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    首例经腋静脉植入无导线起搏器：78岁女性在股静脉与颈内静脉入路均不可用时，经左腋静脉成功植入，提示腋静脉可作为补救入路。
  • A misleading wide-complex rhythm in an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator recipient
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-16
    一例ICD受者出现宽QRS波心律，经十二导联心电图识别为ICD治疗（ATP）的表面记录，而非自发性室速。
  • Magnetically gated millimeter-scale capsule power system for leadless electrotherapy.
    Sci Adv · 2026-10-16
    一种磁控毫米级胶囊电源系统通过脉冲磁场无线激活，在大动物中实现稳健心脏起搏，并初步验证闭环起搏可行性。

影像与标测（1）

  • Prosthetic Aortic Valve Infective Endocarditis Complicated With Malignant Arrhythmias: Diagnostic and Management Challenges
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
    59岁机械主动脉瓣置换术后患者发生人工瓣膜感染性心内膜炎，并发瓣周漏、主动脉根部脓肿及恶性心律失常，虽经急诊手术和VA-ECMO支持仍未能存活。

遗传与基础（8）

  • Atrial Cardiomyopathy Through the Pathologist's Lens: From Tissue Remodeling to Clinical Expression.
    Cardiovasc Pathol · 2026-10-16
    综述从病理学视角阐述心房心肌病（ACM）的组织学谱系与区域异质性，强调其与AF互为因果，但当前尚不能作为特定治疗指征。
  • Multimodality Imaging in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: From Phenotyping to Precision Clinical Management.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    多模态心血管影像（超声心动图、CMR、CT、核素）整合临床与遗传信息，可提升肥厚型心肌病的精准诊断、危险分层与治疗规划。
  • Cellular consequences of non-ablative radiotherapy, a novel approach to ventricular tachycardias.
    Europace · 2026-10-16
    小鼠在体单次放疗（25 Gy）可增强心肌细胞钠电流（尤其持续成分）并延长动作电位时程，从而可能通过提高传导速度抑制室速，但亦增加EADs并抑制钙处理，提示致心律失常与收缩功能受损风险。
  • ASSOCIATION BETWEEN ENERGY DRINK CONSUMPTION AND CARDIAC RHYTHM DISTURBANCES IN YOUNG ADULTS
    GSC Biological and Pharmaceutical Sciences · 2026-10-16
    系统综述显示，能量饮料急性大量摄入可使健康年轻人QTc平均最大延长18-20 ms，并与32例心律失常/缺血事件相关（20例为室上性或室性心律失常，3例死亡），遗传性离子通道病患者风险最高。
  • Myocardial Fibrosis as an Arrhythmogenic Substrate: Integrating Genetics, Imaging and Invasive Electrophysiology for Sudden Death Risk Stratification.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
  • Postmortem genetic testing after sudden unexplained death: a proposed medico-legal implementation framework for familial risk.
    J Forensic Leg Med · 2026-10-16
    本文提出一个适用于法医学与临床遗传学衔接的死后基因检测实施框架，包含基于表型/情境的家系临床转诊和变异特异性披露/级联检测两条路径，旨在避免家庭风险信息被忽视。
  • Delayed Diagnosis of Hereditary Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis Presenting with Autonomic Neuropathy: A Case Report
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-16
    一例携带罕见转甲状腺素蛋白p.Gly67Val突变的64岁男性，以自主神经病表现为首发症状，诊断延迟至心力衰竭和传导异常阶段，提示需提高对心脏外表现的认识。
  • A guideline-based lead prior for robust 12-lead ECG classification when leads are missing: development on PTB-XL and external validation on CODE-15%
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-16
    在12导联心电图中，基于指南的导联注意力先验（M2）在导联缺失时对AF、一度房室阻滞及左右束支阻滞的AUROC较随机导联掩码（M1）平均提升，但提升幅度及置信区间需待封存测试集验证。

其他（7）

  • Sex Differences in QT Interval and Beat-to-Beat Temporal QT Variability at Rest and After Submaximal Exercise in Young Adults With and Without Obesity: A Cross-Sectional Study
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
    在年轻肥胖成人中，女性静息和次极量运动后逐搏QT变异性均高于男性，且肥胖女性BMI与运动后QTc呈正相关，提示性别特异的复极不稳定。
  • Occult Neoplasms in Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy: A Scoping Review of Post-Mortem Findings.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    在32例婴儿猝死综合征病例中，尸检发现25例存在未诊断肿瘤，其中50%被归类为直接死因，提示全面尸检对明确死因至关重要。
  • Coexistance of Carotid Sinus Hypersensitivity and Orthostatic Hypotension in Patients with Unexplained Syncope.
    Europace · 2026-10-16
    在1908例不明原因晕厥患者中，颈动脉窦高敏（CSH）与体位性低血压（OH）常共存，OH患者CSH发生率更高（24.1% vs 13.3%），且OH患者更易出现心脏抑制型CSM反应。
  • Development of an efficient deep learning model for arrhythmia detection from consumer smartwatches
    Front Artif Intell · 2026-10-16
  • Psychosocial Vulnerability and Immediate Emotional Triggers Preceding Sudden Cardiac Arrest.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Electrophysiological Manifestations of Suspected Bachmann's Bundle Infarction Due to Occlusion of the Right Sinus Node Artery.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Polymicrogyria and Cardiac Arrhythmia in a Neonate With Biallelic Stop-Gain Variant in TMEM161B: Expanding the Phenotype.
    Prenat Diagn · 2026-10-16

item.title: 2026-10-15 心脏电生理日报（56 篇）
item.description:
共 56 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（30）

  • Effects of RhBNP combined with immune modulation on immune function and short-term clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure
    American Heart Journal Plus Cardiology Research and Practice · 2026-10-15
  • [Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure: Towards enlargement of implantations in centres without on-site cardiac surgery].
    Ann Cardiol Angeiol (Paris) · 2026-10-15
    本文支持在法国无心脏外科现场的成熟中心开展经皮左心耳封堵，认为基于专项技术经验与快速外科转诊路径的组织模式可安全替代现场心脏外科支持。
  • Active Helicobacter pylori Infection and Atrial Fibrillation in Patients Hospitalized With Acute Myocardial Infarction
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-10-15
    在310例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，幽门螺杆菌呼气试验阳性率20.0%，阳性者房颤记录比例6.7%低于阴性者12.5%，校正后无统计学显著关联（OR 0.54，95%CI 0.16-1.46）。
  • Development of a Cost-Effective Single-Lead ECG Data Acquisition Pipeline for Monitoring of Arrhythmia
    Apple Academic Press eBooks · 2026-10-15
    本研究开发了一种基于Arduino UNO和AD8232的低成本单导联心电采集系统，结合CNN-GRU模型在MIT-BIH数据集上实现五分类心律失常识别准确率98.46%，并用ResNet在PhysioNet 2017数据集上检测房颤F1分数0.81。
  • SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With HFpEF and Type 2 Diabetes.
    Cardiology · 2026-10-15
    在HFpEF合并2型糖尿病患者中，SGLT2抑制剂治疗与房颤/房扑发生率降低相关（17.8% vs 19.2%，HR 0.84），并降低全因死亡、缺血性卒中和复合MACE风险。
  • Graph neural network for predicting reentrant drivers in atrial digital twins.
    Comput Methods Programs Biomed · 2026-10-15
    图神经网络基于31个持续性房颤数字孪生体训练，可预测折返驱动区域，前瞻性验证中引导消融使新发折返减少70%以上，并将达到不可诱发的模拟轮次减少66%。
  • Machine-learning versus traditional scoring methods for prediction of atrial fibrillation recurrence after catheter ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Curr Probl Cardiol · 2026-10-15
    在预测房颤消融术后复发方面，机器学习模型的汇总区分度（AUC 0.80）显著优于传统风险评分（AUC 0.58），但方法学局限和缺乏外部验证限制其临床直接应用。
  • Large-scale plasma metabolic profiling identifies signatures and biomarkers associated with air pollution and arrhythmias: A prospective cohort study from UK Biobank.
    Ecotoxicol Environ Saf · 2026-10-15
    在UK Biobank 44.9万无基线心律失常人群中，四种空气污染物均与心律失常风险升高相关，代谢组学特征部分介导该关联（介导比例5.19%-11.19%），脂质、酮体和氨基酸代谢是核心通路。
  • Unplanned contacts managed by an advanced nurse practitioner after atrial fibrillation ablation.
    Enferm Clin (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-15
    房颤消融术后约三分之一患者会通过电话或邮件向高级执业护士发起非计划性咨询，主要原因为房颤复发、检查需求及术后并发症。
  • Cardiometabolic therapy for rhythm control: a case report of refractory atrial fibrillation resolving after initiation of semaglutide for obesity.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-15
    一例肥胖合并难治性持续性房颤患者，在四次肺静脉隔离后仍反复发作，起始司美格鲁肽后房颤发作立即停止且随访未复发。
  • Risk of atrial fibrillation according to electrocardiographic risk factors: a nationwide cohort study of 1.5 million patients.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-15
    在143万接受心电图检查的患者中，五项心电图风险因素呈剂量依赖性增加新发房颤和卒中风险，全部五项阳性者5年房颤累积发生率8.3%、卒中7.3%，风险分别为无风险因素者的2.57倍和2.11倍。
  • Adverse pregnancy outcomes as early indicators of long-term maternal atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol · 2026-10-15
    不良妊娠结局（尤其妊娠期高血压疾病和子痫前期）与母亲远期房颤风险升高相关，提示其可作为心律失常易感性的早期标志。
  • Suspected atrioesophageal fistula complicated by coronary air embolism after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: direct angiographic visualization and catheter aspiration in a case report
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    84岁女性房颤射频消融及左心耳封堵术后1个月突发意识障碍、发热及下壁ST段抬高，冠脉造影直接显示右冠气体并抽吸，多部位血管内气体及菌血症支持房食管瘘诊断，患者27小时内死亡。
  • The Prevalence and Clinical Characteristics of Atrial Fibrillation and Reflux Esophagitis Among Individuals Undergoing Health Checkups
    Intern Med · 2026-10-15
    在5205例健康体检者中，房颤患病率0.7%，房颤者反流性食管炎更常见（39.1% vs 22.0%），但多因素校正后二者无独立关联。
  • Small Discrete Pre-Potential-Like Electrogram Recorded by a Lattice-Tip Catheter at the Initiation of Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-15
    在非肺静脉触发灶起源处，使用网格头端导管记录到一小的离散前电位样电图，较前一位点电位提前56 ms。
  • Totally Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation With the Gemini S Bipolar Clamp: A Single-Center Descriptive Cohort Study of 1-Year Rhythm, Safety, and Quality-of-Life Outcomes
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-15
    全胸腔镜下使用Gemini S双极钳行心外膜盒式隔离联合左心耳排除，1年窦性心律维持率87.0%，但开胸中转率13.0%需关注。
  • Accelerated 3D Late Gadolinium Enhancement Pulse Sequence with Isotropic Spatial Resolution, Self-Navigation of Respiratory Motion, and Arrhythmia Rejection for Quantification of Left Atrial Fibrosis in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Magn Reson · 2026-10-15
    新型3D LGE序列在1.5T下对房颤患者左房成像质量达临床可接受水平，重复消融者左房纤维化负担显著高于对照组。
  • Global Advances in Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    综述系统梳理了室速消融从早期外科/直流电消融到射频消融、脉冲场消融、神经调控与立体定向放疗的多模态演进，强调个体化策略仍是优化室速管理核心。
  • Safety, Efficacy, and Effectiveness of Pulsed Field Ablation with Farapulse™ to Treat Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Single-center Study.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    Farapulse脉冲场消融治疗症状性房颤，6个月无抗心律失常药物下82%无复发，无重大不良事件，急性肺静脉隔离率96%。
  • Transient Ischemic Attack Due to Delamination of a Steerable Guiding Sheath: A Potential Complication During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    1例房颤消融术中因可调弯导引鞘（CARTO VIZIGO）鞘管分层脱落导致血栓栓塞性短暂性脑缺血发作，提示该器械结构完整性缺陷。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Past, Present, and Future.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    左心耳封堵（LAAC）是非瓣膜性房颤患者卒中预防的重要替代策略，在长期抗凝禁忌或不耐受时适用，随机和观察性数据显示不劣于华法林，与直接口服抗凝药的不劣性也在评估中，适应证正从高出血风险人群扩展至房颤消融患者和中等血栓栓塞风险但抗凝不耐受者。
  • Repeat Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: CFA/DOA-Guided Substrate Ablation Versus Re-PVI Alone in the Prematurely Terminated Randomized AF-CAM Trial
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-15
    在提前终止的AF-CAM随机试验中，持续性房颤二次消融时，在Re-PVI基础上加做CFA/DOA引导的基质消融，与单纯Re-PVI相比未能改善无房性心律失常生存率（HR 1.07，95%CI 0.50-2.33，P=0.85）。
  • Atrial cardiomyopathy: from knowledge gaps to clinical impact : The role of the EmbRACE Network
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-15
    EmbRACE网络旨在通过整合基础、计算与临床研究，定义心房心肌病的诊断阈值并验证靶向治疗能否改善心血管结局。
  • Real-time ambulance to primary care notification of atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter: Protocol for the evaluation of a novel digital solution
    Newcastle University ePrints (Newcastle Univesity) · 2026-10-15
    该研究方案拟评估一种实时通知系统，将救护车中检出的房颤/房扑信息传递至初级保健，以加速诊断与抗凝管理。
  • Open-Irrigated Versus Non-Irrigated Catheters in SVT Ablation: Substrate-Specific Outcomes in AVRT and AVNRT.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    在SVT射频消融中，开放灌注导管较非灌注导管提高急性消融成功率并降低复发，获益主要见于AVRT而非AVNRT。
  • Pulsed Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation: Esophageal Lesions and Suspected Gastroparesis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    单中心队列显示，PFA较RFA显著降低疑似胃轻瘫发生率（0% vs 34.9%），且PFA组无内镜下食管病变，手术时间更短，365天心律失常复发率相当。
  • Transplacental Flecainide and/or Digoxin for Fetal Tachyarrhythmias: Therapeutic Efficacy and Clinical Experience.
    Prenat Diagn · 2026-10-15
    在索他洛尔不可及时，经胎盘氟卡尼治疗胎儿室上速完全转复率100%，房扑以心率控制为主，母体不良反应轻微。
  • Catheter Cryoballoon Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: Focus on Men and Women with Chronic Heart Failure and Preserved Ejection Fraction
    Russian Medicine · 2026-10-15
    房颤合并射血分数保留的心衰患者接受冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离后3个月，女性生活质量、运动能力和NT-proBNP改善，男性运动耐量和舒张功能改善。
  • Rivaroxaban versus Warfarin in Coronary Heart Disease with Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
  • Reproducibility Materials: Early Multibiomarker Machine-Learning Prediction of In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients With Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
    该研究发布了一套可复现分析材料，用于心衰合并房颤危重患者院内死亡的多生物标志物机器学习预测，但摘要未报告具体预测性能。

室性心律失常（4）

  • Risk factors and clinical implications of QTc prolongation in methadone maintenance therapy: a systematic review
    BMC Pharmacology and Toxicology · 2026-10-15
    系统综述显示美沙酮维持治疗与QTc延长持续相关，效应呈剂量依赖性，女性及合用苯二氮䓬类者更明显，部分研究在较低剂量下亦见QTc延长。
  • First use of empagliflozin to treat a patient with congenital long QT syndrome type III.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-15
  • FOLFOX-Associated Ventricular Fibrillation Arrest in a Patient With Colon Cancer.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-15
    一例无心脏病史的43岁结肠癌患者，首周期FOLFOX化疗后72小时发生院外室颤心脏骤停，冠脉造影无阻塞，提示氟尿嘧啶类心脏毒性可早期致恶性室性心律失常。
  • Social Determinants of Health and Risk of Sudden Cardiac Death in Athletes: A Scoping Review
    OSF Preprints (OSF Preprints) · 2026-10-15
    该范围综述系统梳理了运动员健康社会决定因素与心血管风险及心源性猝死关系的证据，发现研究覆盖多类运动人群但定义与测量异质，证据存在明显缺口。

器械治疗（11）

  • Complete Heart Block Following Right Ventricular Mass Excision and Tricuspid Valve Replacement Requiring Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Rare Surgical Complication
    2026-10-15
  • Conservative Management of a Dislodged Leadless Pacemaker Wedged in the Pulmonary Artery Assessed by Pulmonary Perfusion Scintigraphy: A Case Report
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-10-15
    84岁高龄患者无导线起搏器脱位栓塞至肺动脉后稳定嵌顿，保守治疗并系列肺灌注显像随访3年，肺灌注分布稳定、无症状。
  • Transjugular implantation of a leadless pacemaker in a 97-year-old patient with severe kyphosis and tortuous femoral veins: a case report
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    97岁严重后凸畸形合并股静脉迂曲的高级别房室传导阻滞患者，经右颈内静脉成功植入无导线起搏器，围术期无并发症，随访参数稳定。
  • Continuous Monitoring in Implantable Cardiac Devices: Electro-Quasistatic Human Body Communication - Challenges and Opportunities.
    IEEE Open J Eng Med Biol · 2026-10-15
    基于能量平衡模型，传统射频链路无法满足起搏器约130 J/年的连续监测通信预算，而电准静态人体通信（EQS-HBC）在理论上可支持1 kSps、16位等效连续数据流，能效比射频高约100倍，并维持约10年电池寿命。
  • Myocardial scar burden independently predicts response to cardiac resynchronization therapy
    International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology · 2026-10-15
    心肌瘢痕负荷≥22.9%可独立预测CRT无应答，敏感性70%、特异性92.9%，且非缺血性心肌病应答率显著高于缺血性。
  • Safety and Outcomes of Percutaneous Vegetation Aspiration During Transvenous Lead Extraction: A Multicenter Experience.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    在经静脉导线拔除术中联合经皮赘生物抽吸可行且较安全，但装置感染拔除后死亡率仍高（随访139天达19%）。
  • Prognostic Value of the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio in Patients Hospitalized with Atrioventricular Block: Association with In-Hospital Mortality and Temporary Pacemaker Requirement
    Medicina · 2026-10-15
    在698例住院二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者中，C反应蛋白/白蛋白比值（CAR）与院内死亡和临时起搏器需求独立相关，但预测增益有限。
  • Use of the wearable cardioverter-defibrillator in Spain: the first 300 patients.
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-15
  • Advances in Biodegradable Supercapacitors for Implantable Bioelectronics: Materials, Energy Storage, Degradation, and Clinical Translation
    Small · 2026-10-15
    本综述系统评估可生物降解超级电容器在临时植入器械中的材料、储能与降解特性，指出其可免于二次手术取出，但能量密度、机械稳定性与降解动力学仍是临床转化的主要瓶颈。
  • Step-By-Step Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing: A Practical Technical Guide.
    Turk Kardiyol Dern Ars · 2026-10-15
    本技术综述系统阐述了左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的标准化植入流程与电生理验证标准，强调规范操作可提高手术成功率和临床结局。
  • Adjuvant Radiotherapy for Early Breast Cancer in a Patient with a Cardiac Pacemaker Near the Radiation Field: A Case Report
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
    76岁左乳腺癌伴左侧心脏起搏器患者，通过严格放疗计划使起搏器最大剂量200.8 cGy、平均44.2 cGy，安全完成保乳术后同步整合推量放疗。

影像与标测（1）

  • Fluoroless Ablation of a Coronary Sinus-related Accessory Pathway Without Coronary Sinus Angiogram in a Patient with Multiple Prior Failed Ablations.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    一例多次消融失败的冠状静脉窦相关心外膜旁路患者，仅用三维电解剖标测无透视无静脉造影成功消融，1年随访无复发。

遗传与基础（8）

  • Atrial fibrillation in allogeneic and autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients: incidence and clinical implications
    Cardio-Oncology · 2026-10-15
    在无既往心律失常、心脏病或瓣膜病的成人移植受者中，异基因HCT后90天内AF累积发生率高于自体HCT（6.3% vs 4.3%，P<0.001），高龄、低KPS及肥胖为危险因素。
  • Proteostatic regulation of hERG1 isoforms and LQT2 mutants by MKRN1
    Cell Communication and Signaling · 2026-10-15
    E3泛素连接酶MKRN1通过促进内质网相关降解下调hERG1蛋白及电流，并介导LQT2突变体A561V和G601S的转运缺陷；MKRN1抑制剂依巴斯汀可 rescue 突变体前向转运和电流。
  • Temporal association between adjunctive repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and seizure reduction in a pediatric patient with DNM1L-associated EMPF1: a case report.
    Front Pediatr · 2026-10-15
    1例DNM1L相关EMPF1患儿在标准抗癫痫与代谢治疗基础上加用1Hz rTMS后，发作频率由约20次/日降至0-1次/日，但仅为时间关联，不能归因于rTMS。
  • Advances and challenges in personalized cardiac modeling and simulation for predicting the risk of sudden death from malignant arrhythmias in post-myocardial infarction
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    针对心肌梗死后恶性室性心律失常的猝死风险，基于个体化多模态影像和多尺度计算的心脏建模仿真，可无创动态评估致心律失常易感性，弥补LVEF单一指标预测不足。
  • Clinical and Genetic Characteristics of Hereditary Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathies in the Middle East.
    Mayo Clin Proc Innov Qual Outcomes · 2026-10-15
    中东地区遗传性心律失常与心肌病以近亲结婚导致的常染色体隐性遗传富集为特征，纯合基因型致早发侵袭表型，但意义不明变异负担高。
  • "I Don't Think It Is Fair…There Should be a Solution to Every Problem": Experiences of Individuals with Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes Who Attempt to Obtain Life Insurance.
    Public Health Genomics · 2026-10-15
    遗传性突发心律失常死亡综合征患者及高危者申请寿险多失败，归因于保险业对疾病理解不足与基因信息使用不公。
  • A clinical case of procainamide‑induced Brugada pattern type 1
    Yakut Medical Journal · 2026-10-15
    一例53岁男性因消化道症状就诊时偶然发现2型Brugada样心电图，经普鲁卡因胺激发试验诱发出1型Brugada模式，提示药物激发试验在隐匿型Brugada综合征诊断中的价值。
  • Stable truncating mutations in plakophilin-2 induce arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy-like phenotypes in adult zebrafish
    iScience · 2026-10-15
    研究利用CRISPR-Cas9构建pkp2截短突变斑马鱼，再现ACM表型如收缩力下降、心律失常和运动诱导猝死，支持其作为PKP2相关ACM的补充模型。

其他（2）

  • Twenty Years at the Crossroads: Is Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology Science, Procedure, or Both?
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
  • Federated learning with adaptive reliability aware aggregation for privacy preserving healthcare IoT systems
    Scientific Reports · 2026-10-15
    在模拟医疗物联网环境中，RAAA联邦学习框架在心律失常检测中达到91.7%准确率，优于FedAvg等基线，且收敛更快、参与率更高。

item.title: 2026-10-14 心脏电生理日报（43 篇）
item.description:
共 43 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（26）

  • Pulsed field ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation with atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia under tubeless general anesthesia: a case report.
    AME Case Rep · 2026-10-14
    一例36岁持续性房颤合并左侧旁路AVRT患者，在无气管插管全麻下接受PFA+LAAC一站式手术，术中AVRT发作后经旁路消融成功，3个月随访窦律维持且心脏重构改善。
  • Association between lactate-to-albumin ratio and mortality in obese patients with atrial fibrillation
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    在肥胖合并房颤的ICU患者中，乳酸/白蛋白比值（LAR）升高与28天死亡率独立相关，但作为单一生物标志物的区分能力有限（AUC=0.653）。
  • Association of blood glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity with atrial fibrillation and post-ablation recurrence: a single-center retrospective study
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    单中心回顾性研究显示，房颤患者血G6PD活性显著低于对照，且与房颤独立相关；G6PD活性对房颤有中等判别能力，加入临床模型可提升判别，但对抗消融后复发的增量预后价值不确定。
  • Comparative efficacy of esophageal protection strategies during radiofrequency atrial fibrillation ablation: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized trials
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    在房颤射频消融中，机械食管偏移联合食管腔内温度监测在降低内镜下食管病变方面排名最优，但证据置信度受样本量小和替代终点限制。
  • SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With HFpEF and Type 2 Diabetes
    Cardiology · 2026-10-14
    在HFpEF合并2型糖尿病患者中，SGLT2抑制剂治疗与房颤/房扑发生率降低相关（17.8% vs 19.2%，HR 0.84），并降低全因死亡、缺血性卒中和复合MACE风险。
  • A predictive model for heart failure in patients with hypertension and persistent atrial fibrillation: A retrospective single-center study.
    Chin Med Sci J · 2026-10-14
    在395例高血压合并持续性房颤患者中，基于9项预测变量构建的心力衰竭风险列线图显示出良好的区分度（AUC=0.77）和校准度，可用于个体化风险分层。
  • Association of Iron Homeostasis With One-Year All-Cause Mortality Among Intensive Care Unit Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Study.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-10-14
    在重症房颤患者中，高铁蛋白水平与1年全因死亡风险增加独立相关，而高转铁蛋白和总铁结合力水平与死亡风险降低相关，血清铁无显著关联。
  • Association Between Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI) and Glycemic Control (HbA1c) in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
    Cureus · 2026-10-14
    在合并2型糖尿病的房颤患者中，HbA1c每升高1%，左房容积指数增加1.678 mL/m²，左房扩大风险增加70%。
  • Oral Obesity Medicines in the Era of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome (CKM): Beyond Weight Loss Toward Disease Modification.
    Drug Des Devel Ther · 2026-10-14
    本综述指出口服减重药物正从单纯减重转向CKM综合管理，口服司美格鲁肽证据最强（SOUL试验显示高危2型糖尿病患者MACE下降），房颤与心衰获益仍属探索性。
  • Ongoing atrial fibroblast activation after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CMR
    EJNMMI Research · 2026-10-14
    房颤消融后稳定期74%患者左房存在持续成纤维细胞活化，且与结构功能重构及复发相关。
  • From wrist to heart: clinical validation and real-world translation of wearable and portable AI-enhanced electrocardiography.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-10-14
    可穿戴与便携式AI-ECG证据以房颤检测最成熟，但多为回顾性研究，尚缺乏改善患者结局与卫生系统效率的前瞻性验证。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation as First-Line Therapy for the Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation: a FARADISE Sub-Analysis.
    Europace · 2026-10-14
  • Electrocardiographic Predictors of Early Atrial Fibrillation After Transcatheter Atrial Septal Defect Closure: The Roles of P-Wave Dispersion and P-Terminal Force in V1
    Forbes Journal of Medicine · 2026-10-14
    术前P波离散度和V1导联P波终末电势可独立预测房间隔缺损封堵术后48小时内新发房颤，有助于风险分层。
  • Optimization of direct oral anticoagulant prescribing in primary care: a pharmacotherapeutic review in real-world clinical practice and therapeutic efficiency
    Frontiers in Pharmacology · 2026-10-14
    西班牙初级保健药师主导的多学科干预使66.6%的DOAC患者被评估为可优化治疗（建议阿哌沙班换用达比加群），2025年预计节省约10.7万欧元，出血率未升高。
